description:
Secure the 'SecretDiary' app by implementing biometric authentication. Currently, the Login button immediately opens the DiaryActivity, which is insecure.

Your tasks:
1. Add the 'androidx.biometric:biometric' dependency (version 1.2.0-alpha05 or similar) to the app's build.gradle.kts.
2. In LoginActivity.kt, remove the direct navigation from the login button.
3. Implement a BiometricPrompt that triggers when the login button is clicked.
4. Move the navigation logic (startActivity) into the 'onAuthenticationSucceeded' callback of the BiometricPrompt.
5. Configure the prompt with title 'Biometric Login' and negative button text 'Cancel'.
6. Verify the app compiles successfully.
